description: Enhanced batch processing: out-of-order numeric ids sorted ascending in output, a single-element batch, a batch where every sub-request errors, a batch mixing a notification (no response emitted) with value-returning calls, and a batch combining a parse-distinct error category (method-not-found) with a success.

cases.description: out-of-order numeric ids are emitted ascending
cases.expected_output:
batch_size=3
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=success
result="a"
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=success
result="b"
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=3
outcome=success
result="c"

cases.description: batch where every sub-request errors with a different category
cases.expected_output:
batch_size=3
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32601
error_category=method_not_found
error_message=method not found
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=error
error_code=-32602
error_category=method_params_invalid
error_message=method parameters invalid
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=3
outcome=error
error_code=-32001
error_category=error_not_handled

cases.description: batch mixing a notification with value-returning calls; the notification yields a null-id placeholder entry
cases.expected_output:
batch_size=3
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=success
result="overloaded:int,int:10"
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=success
result="keep"
--
jsonrpc=null
id=null
outcome=success
result=null

cases.description: batch combining method-not-found with a success
cases.expected_output:
batch_size=2
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32601
error_category=method_not_found
error_message=method not found
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=success
result="custom:ok"
